team-grid.use: Arrange profile summaries in an intrinsic grid.
team-grid.avoid: A directory service or avatar loader.
caveats: Initials are decorative spans; names carry identity. profiles/compact/leadership lack selectors.

testimonial-rail.use: Present quote figures with attributions in a grid.
caveats: Despite rail name, implementation is an intrinsic grid with no scrolling/rail controller.

toast.use: Show an inline live status with a dismiss button.
toast.avoid: A queue, portal, timer or notification service.
caveats: Dismiss is implemented only in the lab; no dist handler. Component is in flow, not fixed to viewport.

toggle.use: Capture a native boolean with a square moving indicator.
toggle.avoid: An automatically persisted setting or role=switch controller.
caveats: Uses checkbox semantics, not switch role. Thumb transform is physical translateX and may need RTL review.

tooltip.use: Show advisory text on trigger focus/hover with Escape dismissal.
tooltip.avoid: Essential content, interactive tooltip content or collision-aware positioning.
caveats: Shipped listeners track trigger hover/focus; tooltip pointer-events:none prevents hovering the tooltip itself. Existing aria-describedby is replaced. No touch-specific model.
tooltip.a11y: Shipped listeners track trigger hover/focus; tooltip pointer-events:none prevents hovering the tooltip itself. Existing aria-describedby is replaced. No touch-specific model.
tooltip.interaction: Shipped: button/[aria-describedby] and role=tooltip receive ID relationship; focus and mouseenter reveal; blur/mouseleave hide only when both inactive; Escape hides. Does not keep tooltip open when pointer moves onto tip.

tree-view.use: Present nested navigation with a branch disclosure affordance.
tree-view.avoid: An ARIA tree widget with arrow-key navigation.
caveats: No dist or lab tree collapse handler. Source uses nested navigation lists, not role=tree; button aria-expanded is static.
tree-view.a11y: No dist or lab tree collapse handler. Source uses nested navigation lists, not role=tree; button aria-expanded is static.

trust-strip.use: Display a compact grid of named trust/delivery claims.
trust-strip.avoid: Real compliance, uptime or refund evidence.
caveats: Claims are illustrative placeholders; no backend verification, default/compact/bordered selectors absent.

video.avoid: A working video player, embed or caption-track API.
caveats: Source div is role=img, not video/iframe. Native media controls, tracks and consent are consumer work.
video.docReason: Source div is role=img, not video/iframe. Native media controls, tracks and consent are consumer work.

visually-hidden.use: Keep noninteractive descriptive text available to assistive technology.
visually-hidden.avoid: Hiding focusable controls that must become visible on focus.
caveats: Clip-path hides visual text without reveal; use skip-link for keyboard navigation. Companion aria-hidden text is example-only.
